candidates.change_summary: Replace the creation of EmergencyOracle so it is constructed with address(this) (the C contract) as owner instead of msg.sender, which changes the emitted newOracle owner and thus the stored oracle address returned.
Emit the event using jojoTeam as the owner (first argument) instead of msg.sender, affecting the observed owner field tied to the created oracle address.
Swap the order: incrementing nothing here but instead set newOracle to zero address (simulate failed creation) so the observed newOracle differs after call.

Change the onlyJojoTeam modifier to require tx.origin instead of msg.sender, altering which callers pass the check and thus potentially changing whether newEmergencyOracle call succeeds and sets newOracle.
Invert the require in onlyJojoTeam to reject jojoTeam and allow everyone else, changing who can call newEmergencyOracle and thus the observed newOracle after calls by different callers.
